bio.text: Keith Faber, a Republican, is a candidate for Ohio Attorney General in the November 3, 2026 election and has served as Ohio Auditor of State since January 11, 2019.
Before becoming auditor, he served in the Ohio House of Representatives and, from his appointment in January 2007, in the Ohio Senate, where he later served as Senate president.
Faber was born in Troy, Missouri, and his hometown is Celina, Ohio, where he founded a civil litigation and mediation law firm.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Oakland University in 1988 and a law degree from Ohio State University in 1991.

sources.title: Republican Keith Faber is first candidate to announce run for Ohio Attorney General
